name: azmap.dev Microsoft 365 tenant domain map
operator: azmap.dev (unidentified operator; community service used by bbot azure_tenant and corptrace)
tier_rationale: No published terms or privacy policy and no identifiable operator (A8 unknown): 'azmap.dev (no published terms, unknown operator) is a separate adapter module m365_tenant_azmap: default_enabled=False, terms unknown and tier unknown' (P011 cond 6). Whether queries are logged or reused is unknown: the unknown tier already keeps it out of TLP:AMBER and above and limits it to IOC values with --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN.

reliability.justification: Third-party index of the domains verified in an Entra ID tenant; plausible and broadly correct (microsoft.com lists GitHub, LinkedIn, Xbox) but unverifiable, so every related domain is DNS-confirmed (MX *.mail.protection.outlook.com or TXT MS=) before it pivots (P011 cond 7).

tenant.title: azmap.dev /api/tenant?domain={domain}&extract=true (tenant id and name, brand, related domains)

terms.quote: Third-party service, no published terms found.

tenant.notes: Research C0001. Disabled until legal records its terms and a promotion; even then excluded at AMBER and above; one call per domain, cache 24 h (P011 cond 6). 404 {'error': 'DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND'} = no Entra ID tenant (EMPTY). bbot's azure_tenant module (AGPL-3.0) is study material only: the technique is re-implemented (A6).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-2 (P011 cond 6-7, module m365_tenant_azmap). The queried domain is disclosed to an unknown operator (OPSEC): IOC values only, never personal identifiers (A8).
